text: My name is Leo Caillard. I am a French artist and I love marble sculpting. I am a marble sculptor for more than 20 years. The main focus of my art is to open a dialogue in between the past and the future. So mixing block of marble and blockchain is very interesting to me because we live in a modern world, the digital world. Everything is fast, quick, liquid, easy to move. Marble is the opposite. It's physical, dense, intense. Blockchain is a good way to modernize physical marble sculptures. The certification, the real world asset, is something that interests me. And the way we can use blockchain to maybe split shares of a physical art piece and sell them in multiple ways and see how we could use blockchain to open a new kind of art buying of market in terms of physical art. Being a marble sculptor, it's always surprising for the people because they don't see that every day. So I like to see the surprise, the astonishment in the eyes of the viewers when they arrive at the Solana space and they think they are just looking at digital art or maybe some information about blockchain, and suddenly they see a marvel sculptor studio. I think it's important to open the mind. Blockchain is something real, something that exists. It's a pure concrete technology that can be used by different styles of especially physical art. It's not only digital art. And I'm here to show that the main goal of my art is to play with time. It's kind of a dream to achieve the eternal creation, something that will last forever. That's why I do marble carving, because when you work on stone, you work on something that is beyond your own lifetime, and I love that.
